description: This Java source file defines the primary class 'ECUEditor' for the RomRaider ECU editing application. It manages UI components, including menus, toolbars, and image tables; handles loading, displaying, and removing ROM images; and includes background worker classes for asynchronous tasks like opening and closing images, setting user levels, and launching the logger. The class integrates various UI elements, event handling, and file operations, serving as the central coordinator of the ECU editing GUI.

classes.name: LaunchLoggerWorker
classes.description: A SwingWorker class responsible for asynchronously launching the ECU logger, updating the status panel, and managing the UI state during the logging process.

classes.name: SetUserLevelWorker
classes.description: A SwingWorker class that refreshes displayed tables for all ROM images when the user level is changed.

classes.name: CloseImageWorker
classes.description: A SwingWorker class that closes a specified ROM image, cleans up resources, and updates the UI.

classes.name: OpenImageWorker
classes.description: A SwingWorker class that handles asynchronous opening and loading of a ROM image, parsing files, and updating the UI accordingly.

methods.name: ECUEditor
methods.description: Constructor initializing the ECU editor UI, loading settings, and setting up the main components and layout.

methods.name: getContent
methods.description: Returns the main content JPanel of the application.

methods.name: openImage
methods.description: Opens a ROM image file and loads it into the editor, updating the UI.

methods.name: closeImage
methods.description: Closes the currently selected ROM image.

methods.name: setLastSelectedRom
methods.description: Sets the currently selected ROM image.

methods.name: getLastSelectedRom
methods.description: Returns the last selected ROM image.

methods.name: refreshUI
methods.description: Refreshes the UI components to reflect current state.
